y-m-62-04.material: Jinwoo claim: "If quotient (f(a+h)−f(a−h))/(2h) get limit as h dey approach 0, then f differentiable at x=a." (How to read: f of a plus h minus f of a minus h, divided by 2h.) Information below go come one step at a time. At each step choose wetin you think about the claim.

y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Limit of symmetric quotient dey and e equal 0. We must check separately whether this mean f′(0) dey, using definition. Student wey already know say |x| bend at 0 fit see am as counterexample.

y-m-62-04.s.s1.st.2.info: By definition, (f(h)−f(0))/h = |h|/h. E na 1 when h>0 and −1 when h<0, so right limit na 1 and left limit na −1; f′(0) no dey.
